lines.en: How did Mrs. Sterling get her bag back?
lines.cn: 斯特林夫人是怎么拿回她的包的？

lines.en: Mrs. Anne Sterling did not think of the risk
lines.cn: 安妮·斯特林夫人并没有考虑到其中的风险。

lines.en: she was taking when she ran through a forest after two men.
lines.cn: 她正在追赶那两个男人时，突然穿过了一片森林。

lines.en: They had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest
lines.cn: 当她在森林边缘野餐时，他们立刻跑向了她。

lines.en: with her children and tried to steal her handbag.
lines.cn: 她带着自己的孩子，试图偷她的手提包。

lines.en: In the struggle, the strap broke and,
lines.cn: 在挣扎的过程中，那根带子断了。

lines.en: with the bag in their possession,
both men started running through the trees.
lines.cn: 两名男子开始在树林中奔跑。

lines.en: Mrs. Sterling got so angry that she ran after them.
lines.cn: 斯特林太太气得冲了上去追赶他们。

lines.en: She was soon out of breath,
When she caught up with them,
she saw that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag,
lines.cn: 她看到他们已经坐下来，正在翻看包里的东西。

lines.en: so she ran straight at them.
lines.cn: 于是她直接朝他们冲了过去。

lines.en: The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away.
lines.cn: 那些男人吓得魂不附体，立刻扔下包逃跑了。

lines.en: 'The strap needs mending,' said Mrs. Sterling later, 'but they did not steal anything.'
lines.cn: “这条带子需要修理了，”斯特林夫人后来说道，“但他们什么也没偷。”
